ValidationRule.description: Queue can be owner of case only when status of case is new and record type of case is inquiry/Compliment/Comment/Useless/Non-Quality type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess", NOT( OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Status)), ISPICKVAL(Status, "New") ) ), NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:Queue.QueueName)), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Inquiry", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Non_Quality", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Useless", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Compliment", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Comment" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The queue can be Owner of Case only when status is New.
